# dsh-socratic-mode
**A Socratic learning mode for DeepSeek Harness — it gives you one small piece of real knowledge, th
en asks one invitational question. No lectures, no interrogation.**
中文说明 · MIT License
## Why this exists
Most “AI tutor” prompts have the same failure mode: they either lecture at you, or they quiz you for
ever — question after question with nothing given back. Both feel like pressure, and after ten minut
es you stop wanting to chat.
This mode flips the order: **give first, then ask** (先给后问). Every turn hands you one concrete piece
of knowledge — a key distinction, a counter-intuitive fact, a number, a one-line takeaway, or a comm
on misconception — and then invites you to think one step further. Questions are invitations, not in
terrogations. You can always say “just tell me”, “just talk”, or “I'm tired”, and the mode adapts.
## What you get

- A new agent preset — **苏格拉底学习模式** (Socratic Learning Mode) — on the New Session picker.
- A knowle

dge block every turn, so each reply is worth reading even when you don't answer.
- Exactly one quest

ion per turn, always optional.
- Pressure controls: a question-free turn every 4–6 turns, hidden mas

tery checks instead of “exams”, and a graceful exit when you are tired.
- Warm register: specific ap
preciation (quoting your own words), safety when you're stuck, invitations (“what do you think?”) in

stead of commands (“please answer”).
- A **study note** in your workspace at the end: knowledge map,
key distinctions, your own best sentences, misconceptions, and three self-test questions.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness desktop / web, `dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.3`
- Node.js `>= 20` (only for the repo's check s
cript and development)

## Use
Create a new session, pick **苏格拉底学习模式**, and say what you want to learn:
| Goal | Say |

| learn a concept from scratch | 「教我通货膨胀，我基础很差」 |
| study a document | 「用苏格拉底法帮我读这份讲义」 (drop the fil

e into the chat) |
| verify what you know | 「考我文艺复兴，我看过两遍书了」 |
| untangle a confusion | 「我总觉得货币乘数讲不通

e chat) |
| verify what you know | 「考我文艺复兴，我看过两遍书了」 |
| untangle a confusion | 「我总觉得货币乘数讲不通，你来问问我」 |
During the session:
| You want | Say |

| the answer now | 「直接告诉我」 |
| a hint instead | 「卡住了 / 给点提示」 |
| a lecture with no questions | 「讲讲吧」

|
| to stop | 「累了 / 先别考我」 |
| to wrap up | 「总结一下」 → writes a study note |
## What's inside
| Part | File | Purpose |
| Preset declaration | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts `preset-socratic` into the agent-preset roster |
| Teaching method (always on) | `cordis.patch.yml` → `persona.prefix` | 20 hard rules: give-then-as

k, tone, pressure control, hidden mastery checks |
| Teaching method (on demand) | `skills/socratic-
tutor/SKILL.md` | Knowledge-block library, six-question ladder, four hint levels, tone manual, note

template, anti-patterns |
| Display resources | `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, `icon.svg` | Bun
dle card title, description and icon |
The preset mounts 13 child rows: `persona`, `time-context`, `tool-fs`, `tool-fs-search`, `tool-bash`
/`tool-pwsh`, `tool-web`, `skill-filesystem`, `tool-skill`, `tool-ask-user`, `tool-todo`, `present`,
and a compaction group. It deliberately **omits** plan mode, goals, schedules, background jobs, sub
agents, workflows and the plugin manager: a learning session should not carry system-modification to
ts, workflows and the plugin manager: a learning session should not carry system-modification tools.
## Design
Two layers keep the constraints strong without spending context on them every turn:
1. **Persona** (~1.4 KB, visible every turn) — the rules that must beat the model's default habits.
2. **Skill** (~6 KB, loaded once) — the full playbook: knowledge-block templates, question ladder, h
int ladder, tone manual, study-note structure.
The core loop:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Give:** one of five knowledge-block types — key distinction, counter-intuitive fact, concrete ex

ample/number, one-line takeaway, common misconception.
- **Ask:** invitation only (“你会怎么想?” “想不想试试更刁

的?”), never commands (“请回答”).
- **Never:** two questions in one turn, two give-less turns in a row,
judging “right/wrong”, broadcasting progress, or pushing questions when the learner is tired.
Mastery is checked silently — explain it, give your own example, transfer to a new case — and never
announced as a test.
## Customize
| Want | Edit |

| teacher persona and rules | `cordis.patch.yml` → `persona.prefix`, then reinstall the bundle |
| q
uestion ladder, hint ladder, tone manual, note template | `skills/socratic-tutor/SKILL.md` (re-read

on every load, no reinstall needed) |
| tool set | `cordis.patch.yml` → `plugins` |
| roster positio
n | `config.order` (built-ins use 1–4) |
Validate before reinstalling:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Reinstalling an installed bundle needs two steps — `plugin_manager` → `remove_bundle`, then `install
_bundle` (installing over an existing bundle reports `already-installed`).
